**Who is Sonar?**

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

* **SonarQube:** The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
    
* **SonarQube Foundation Agent:** Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
    
* **SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation:** Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.
    

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

* Committed to our customers and community.
    
* Obsessed with quality.
    
* Deliberate in our decisions.
    
* Effective as one team.
    

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

**Position description**

As Sonar’s Marketing AI Engineer, you design, build, and maintain the AI agents and automated workflows that multiply the impact of the marketing function. You spend time with marketing stakeholders to understand their work in depth, identify where automation creates real leverage, and then build and iterate until it works well. You produce clear reporting on efficiency and impact, keeping marketing leadership informed on what the automations are actually delivering.

The best person for this role might be a marketing ops veteran who has taught themselves to build with AI, or an automation engineer who has gone deep on how marketing actually works. Either way, what matters is the combination: you understand marketing processes from the inside, and you can build reliable automations that make those processes faster, smarter, and more scalable.

### What you will do

* **Map and prioritize automation opportunities:** Work closely with marketing teams to develop a deep understanding of their day-to-day processes — identifying where AI agents and automated workflows can eliminate manual work, reduce errors, or unlock capabilities that weren’t previously possible.
    
* **Design and build AI agents:** Develop AI agents and automated workflows that streamline marketing processes — from content production and campaign operations to reporting, lead routing, and personalization at scale.
    
* **Deploy and maintain automations:** Own the full lifecycle of deployed agents — from initial release through ongoing monitoring, debugging, and iteration — ensuring reliability and performance as usage grows.
    
* **Produce efficiency and impact reporting:** Track and report on workflow automation metrics — time saved, error rates, throughput, and business impact — delivering regular dashboards and summaries to marketing leadership.
    
* **Stay current on AI tooling:** Continuously evaluate new AI models, agent frameworks, and automation platforms — bringing a clear point of view on what Sonar marketing should adopt, experiment with, or build on next.
    
* **Partner with Marketing Tooling & AI Operations:** Collaborate closely with the Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager to understand the existing tool stack, ensure automations integrate reliably with it, and drive adoption of new AI-powered capabilities.
    
* **Ensure data quality and governance:** Design automations that handle marketing data responsibly — with attention to data quality, privacy, and auditability across all deployed workflows.
    
* **Document and enable:** Produce clear documentation for all deployed agents and workflows, and run internal enablement sessions to help the marketing team understand and effectively use what you have built.
    

### Experience and qualifications

* Have 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, automation engineering, or a closely related role — with a track record of building workflows or automations that measurably improved team efficiency.
    
* Have deep, hands-on knowledge of marketing processes and tools — including CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation, campaign ops, analytics, and content workflows. A marketing ops practitioner who has grown into building automations is a strong fit.
    
* Be experienced with no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Make, Zapier, n8n) and comfortable extending them with scripting when needed (Python and/or JavaScript).
    
* Have working familiarity with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants) or a demonstrated ability and appetite to ramp quickly.
    
* Be experienced integrating with third-party APIs and working with marketing data structures (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo).
    
* Have strong analytical skills and experience building performance dashboards and reporting for deployed automations.
    
* Be a clear communicator who can explain what an automation does — and why it matters — to non-technical stakeholders, and translate their requirements into precise technical specifications.
    
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a bias to build — you stay current on the fast-moving AI landscape and bring that knowledge into your everyday work.
    
* Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
    

**In-office culture**

We’re intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that’s not where you are today, we’re happy to support relocation for the right person.

**We value diversity, equity, and inclusion**

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. ### About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

## Available Locations: **Austin, US**

## **Applications will be accepted until November 01, 2026.**

## **Job Title: Senior Oracle Security and AI Engineer**

## About the Role

This Senior Oracle Security and AI Engineer is primarily responsible for the Oracle Fusion security architecture, role design governance, oversight of the Risk Management Cloud service and AI initiatives. The Engineer serves as a hands-on expert for the technical administration, environment management, and platform integrity of the Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud environment, operating as a technical owner for Oracle Fusion Applications, Security, and the underlying Cloud and AI Infrastructure.

## Responsibilities

* **Environment Management & Maintenance:** Own the technical management of all Fusion environments, including executing scheduled **environment refreshes**, cloning instances, managing environment usage, and ensuring system configuration baselines.
* **Cloud Update Execution:** Participate in the technical preparation and execution of Oracle’s mandatory quarterly cloud updates, including performing pre-update checks and technical smoke testing post-update.
* **Platform Stability & Governance:** Own the non-functional requirements for the Oracle Cloud environment, including security architecture, role design governance, and performance benchmarking. Enforce technical configuration control standards.
* **Security Administration:** Provide security administration and support for all Oracle Fusion Applications, PaaS and DBaaS platforms. Design, build, and deploy custom security roles for Oracle Fusion Applications, ensuring strict adherence to the principle of least privilege and Segregation of Duties and Sensitive Access compliance frameworks.
* **Risk Management Cloud:** Serve as the technical owner of the Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud service. Configure, deploy, and maintain Advanced Access Controls - AAC and Advanced Financial Controls - AFC to detect and mitigate financial risks, fraud, and policy violations, translating audit requirements into effective platform controls.
* **Technical Support & Troubleshooting:** Provide Level 2/3 technical support for environment-related issues, access problems, and deployment failures. Serve as an escalation point to conduct root cause analysis for platform-level incidents.
* **AI & Automation Innovation:** Evaluate, design, and deploy AI-driven tools, Model Context Protocol implementations/maintenance, Terraform-based automation scripts, and security artifacts to enhance platform security operations, streamline threat monitoring, and optimize governance workflows across the Oracle Cloud ecosystem.

## Role Requirements

## Must-Have Skills

* 8+ years focusing on the technical administration/support within Oracle eco system
* 4+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying custom security roles within the Oracle Fusion Applications environment.
* Expert-level knowledge of managing Oracle Fusion Cloud environments(ERP, GTM and EPM), including environment refresh and cloning processes.
* Deep technical familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure administration and monitoring.
* Strong understanding of security architecture, Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud, role design governance, and performance management within a cloud ERP.
* Strong understanding of various MCP and Agentic capabilities with Oracle Fusion (ERP, EPM, GTM), AI Database, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence.

## Nice-to-Have Skills

* Experience in an organization transitioning to Oracle Cloud Ecosystem.
* Hands-on experience with various OCI PaaS Toolsets.
* Exposure to the Data Center Infrastructure industry
* Relevant professional product/functional certifications (e.g., Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Security certifications)
* Skilled in administering DevOps tools like Flexagon FlexDeploy and using Opal IGA tool
* Experience in Cloudflare’s Developer platform or equivalent(e.g., AWS)

### What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

[**Project Galileo**](https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/): Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

**[Athenian Project](https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/)**: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

[**1.1.1.1**](https://1.1.1.1/): We released [1.1.1.1](https://1.1.1.1/) to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our [privacy commitment](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver) and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
